Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, especially her dolls. One day, her mom gave her a pretty necklace with long, sharp stones and a shiny pocket. 

Lily was so happy with her new necklace and wore it all day long. But then, she accidentally ripped the necklace with her finger. She started to cry and ran to tell her mom. 

Her mom came over and asked, "Why are you crying, Lily?"

Lily said, "My necklace got torn and my favorite necklace. Can you wipe it off now?"
